title: Using the Regent's writ to enter Marrowgate carries reputation costs that are not disclosed anywhere in the choice ('show the Regent's writ at the gate' has no cost annotation, unlike most other costed choices in the game which are consistently labeled, e.g. 'a hit costs standing with X'). It silently cost (the Gray Church -1) and (the Barrow-Keepers -1). Companions comment on the cost afterward ('Paid for in fire, but paid' / 'I keep counting what that writ actually cost') confirming it was intentional, just hidden at the decision point.
where: Marrowgate, South Gate ('show the Regent's writ')
